source.implements: what protects a unit when targeted: Feel No Pain, defensive abilities, detachment rules, stratagems usable in that phase, the Orks riled-up 5+ invulnerable save; on the datasheet (opts.shields) also a stratagem another unit of the list takes the hits with (Grot Shields: a GRETCHIN unit for an ORKS INFANTRY unit, excluding GRETCHIN), and what another unit of the list gives this one when it is attacked (its guard entries whose needs it meets: Emanatus Forcefield, Shroudpsalm, Omnissiah's Blessing, Necromechanic)

Overview (before the battle): Warlord, enhancements, attached units, detachments (each opens its detachment rule), the army rules (folded), units with Deep Strike (24.09: every model must have it), transports, Scouts and Infiltrators (24.31, 24.20: every model must have it), start of the battle / round 1 / every round, once-per-battle items; the army rules block also holds the detachment rules (as on the Rules tab); an enhancement's holder by its full name when another unit of the list has the same short name

the Game tracker's New game: clears this game (round, turn, CP, VP, choices) and the list's uses per battle (the Overview's tick boxes, the same storage), with Undo; the Overview's own New game is as before (the uses per battle only)

a phase's rows: each opens its full text; a stratagem's gist, and which units can use it only when none can; uses per battle as the Overview's ticks, the same keys and boxes (a rule that lets each of its abilities be selected once per battle: one box per ability; a per-unit rule: none); an option of a choice marked picked / not picked this round, a choice's current pick
the rules of a list that give CP, quoted by that sentence (not their FAQ or errata lines): army rules (not inert), detachment rules, unit abilities (usable in the list), each once with its units

the Event Companion's mission sequence with this list's numbers: step 7 the strategic reserves limit (20.01: 50% of the points limit for the battle size, worked out from the list's points limit, marked as an app note) and the units with Deep Strike; step 8 the TITANIC units (its TITANIC sentence set apart when the list has one) and the Infiltrators; step 10 who takes the first turn; step 11 the units with Scouts

a choice: its rule, when the pick is made and how long it lasts in the rule's words (For the battle, Battle round N, Until the start of your next Command phase, Until another is picked; a pick from an earlier round or from the start of the battle says so), its options (an option picked in another battle round of a once-per-battle choice marked used), Rolled, the state (Honoured), the quoted text of each pick, earlier rounds' picks; an app note when its timing names a step the Event Companion's mission sequence does not have ("the Read Mission Objectives step")

a pick: one option (tapped again: none), with up to two a third replaces the first; Rolled and the state on and off; picking an option of a once-per-battle choice (Kindred Sorcery) ticks the Overview's box for it, unpicking it unticks it unless another battle round picked it
